topic: A teacher receives an unexpected gift from a former student
text: I didn't expect to hear from you, not after everything. Your package arrived, wrapped neatly, a tag with my name in your careful handwriting. I touched the letters, thinking back. We had our moments, didn’t we? Times when the words between us were sharper than they needed to be. I walked the familiar path to my favorite spot, the one where I can see the whole valley, and opened your gift. A book, of course, bound in a shade that reminded me of autumn leaves. Inside, a note: "For the one who taught me the weight of words and the power of silence." The weight of your gratitude makes me question the echoes of the past. I hope you find the words to heal, just as you've found the words to thank.
